conversations.topic: Discussing the deadline for finding a place

messages.content: Hey, can you update my notes on the apartment hunting? We went looking again yesterday, but man, the weather was just way too hot.
Got it, I've noted the weekend hunt. Sounds like a sweaty time! Did you guys have any luck despite the heat?
Not really. Liwei noted that a lot of the places we saw had incredibly ugly wallpaper. Plus, we couldn't stop joking about this one super grumpy landlord we met who barely let us look around.
Haha, ugly wallpaper and a grumpy landlord—sounds like a bad sitcom episode. Are you guys getting worried about the timeline? You previously wanted to wrap this up by early August.
Yeah, the pressure is on. I talked it over with her tonight, and I made a serious commitment to Liwei that we will sign a lease for the apartment hunting by August 5th, no matter what.
That's a solid deadline. August 5th it is. I'll make sure to track that commitment for you. Need me to block out some extra time this week to review online listings?
Yes, block out an hour on Wednesday evening. We need to get this locked down before things get crazy with work and the Shenzhen trip.
Done! I've blocked out an hour this Wednesday evening for listing review. You guys will find the right spot before the deadline!

Definitely. To give her some peace of mind, I promised Mom I would invite her over the first weekend after the apartment hunting concludes. She can inspect the water pressure herself!
That's a great idea! I'm sure she’s already looking forward to the grand tour. Just let me know if you need any reminders for the final lease signing.
